# `court_opinion_texts`

**Court opinion texts (Markdown)**

Each CourtListener opinion's text as Markdown in the GitHub Flavored Markdown dialect with footnotes ([^n] references and definitions), its citations as links [cite](opinion:ID) to the cited opinion_id. Join opinion_id to court_opinions and cluster_id to court_opinion_clusters (court_is_federal selects federal courts). An opinion without text has a row with text_source 'none' and NULL markdown; where a PDF of it was extracted, court_opinion_pdf_extractions joins it by opinion_id. Stored id sorted, one file per block of 150,000 opinion ids (opinion_block is opinion_id // 150000). MCP query_sql views enable explicit Hive partition typing on opinion_block, so filtering WHERE opinion_block = '<k>' AND opinion_id = '<id>' prunes directly to one member file. A filter on opinion_id alone opens every member footer. opinion_id is text, so filter it with a quoted literal (opinion_id = '123'); an unquoted number casts every row and prevents row-group pruning. Rows are in numeric id order within a file; ORDER BY opinion_id sorts as text, so order by CAST(opinion_id AS BIGINT). For full-text search, narrow by opinion_block or court_id plus date_filed and include a SQL contains(lower(markdown), '<anchor>') pre-filter inside the CASE guard before calling court_opinion_search_text(). Receipts are retired: each row carries source_column, source_text_sha256, dump_date, and source_sha256 directly, with converter identity, build counts, and any refused rows (court_opinion_texts.exceptions.parquet) recorded in run source evidence.

**Coverage.** Not a range. One row per opinion in a retained CourtListener bulk opinions export, federal or non-federal; select federal courts by joining cluster_id to court_opinion_clusters and filtering court_is_federal. Check describe_table for live availability and row count. *(measured 2026-11-28)*

**Data quality.** Converted with SpicyDocs Converter 003 from html_with_citations, else html, else plain_text; images are dropped and preformatted bodies keep line breaks and indentation. Converter 003 uses GFM inline <em>/<strong> when Markdown emphasis delimiters cannot represent exact publisher boundaries; court_opinion_search_text() skips those formatting tags while keeping visible words. Accepted fidelity thresholds (owner, 2026-10-31): zero lost citation links, headings, blockquotes, or paragraphs; footnotes and italics at most 0.5% lost; tables at most 1% lost. Footnote markers whose source rendering has no matching body remain literal characters and are reported as footnote_markers_without_target rather than fabricated definitions. Any rendering the converter refuses is written to court_opinion_texts.exceptions.parquet with pointer metadata only, never silently coerced to empty text. Read with a GFM parser that supports footnotes.

- **Parquet file:** `court_opinion_texts.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `opinion_id` | `VARCHAR` | CourtListener opinion ID, as text; filter it with a quoted literal (opinion_id = '123'). Primary key; joins court_opinions.opinion_id, court_opinion_pdf_extractions.opinion_id and the opinion ids of court_citation_map. |
| `cluster_id` | `VARCHAR` | CourtListener decision-cluster ID; joins court_opinion_clusters.cluster_id, whose court_is_federal selects federal courts. |
| `opinion_block` | `VARCHAR` | opinion_id // 150000 as text: the partition directory and member file a row is stored in. Filter opinion_block with a quoted literal alongside opinion_id for single-file Hive-pruned lookup. |
| `date_modified` | `VARCHAR` | Timestamp the publisher last modified the opinion record, as the export states it. |
| `text_source` | `VARCHAR` | The export column the Markdown was converted from: html_with_citations, html, plain_text, or none. |
| `markdown` | `VARCHAR` | The opinion body as GitHub Flavored Markdown with footnotes; citations are [text](opinion:ID) or [text](cite:path) links. NULL when text_source is none. |
| `converter_version` | `VARCHAR` | Version of the SpicyDocs opinion Markdown converter (for example `003`); the run source evidence carries its code digest and lxml build. |
| `source_column` | `VARCHAR` | Export column name converted into markdown (`html_with_citations`, `html`, or `plain_text`); NULL when `text_source` is `none`. |
| `source_text_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 of the converted rendering column value (`sha256:` and 64 hex digits); NULL when `text_source` is `none`. |
| `dump_date` | `VARCHAR` | The CourtListener bulk export edition the row was converted from (ISO date). |
| `source_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 of the CourtListener export file the row was read from (`sha256:` and 64 hex digits): the retained original in the raw archive and run source evidence, matching court_opinions.source_sha256. |
